run.command: strata bench run --url http://127.0.0.1:8089 --out <home>/notes/bench/e707/Wd/standard --track custom --track-notes two RX 6900 XT, layer split 27 + on-demand DP read (>=12K tokens); this box's waitlist-0211 build (E708): v0.2.11 + local patch set (on-demand dual data-parallel prompt read from PR #5002 + follow-ups, MMQ wave-uniform activation reads for RDNA2, FP16 hyper-connection/attn_qkv without widening, int8 copies for the persistent hc read on Q8_0's grid (STRATA_HC_PERSIST_Q8=2), dense GEMV and expert-layout tables for gfx1030, fused SwiGLU+quantize; plus PROMPT_ATTN_RDNA2 #3381, PREFILL_CPU_SHARE_BATCH #3382, SELECT_SIMT=2 #3073, PW_WITH_BATCH #3095), production env, --spec 3 --spec-min-p 0.6 --pipeline-windows 2 --prefill-pipe 1600 --mtp-q4 head, kv int8, conversation cache 0, vision off, parallel 1, run-config sampling temperature 0 / presence_penalty 0; cards at 245 W and -81 mV, Ryzen 5 5600X, 128 GB DDR4-3200, PCIe 4.0 x8 per card, Ubuntu 26.04 kernel 7.0.0-42, ROCm 10.0 --build-options STRATA_ENABLE_HIP,CMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx1030,STRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS,STRATA_PREFILL_MMQ,STRATA_Q6K_EXPERTS,STRATA_MMQ_KQUANTS=OFF,GGML_HIP_GRAPHS,GGML_HIP_NO_VMM,STRATA_GGML_DIR=llama.cpp-fb5d45967 (ggml llama-q2k fb5d45967 + RDNA2 MMQ y-scalar patch) --model-revision ed59f92082b1e93c0e96d60a8b11aab089b52f09 --source-revision 4783921b99612c1b1deac3442f7909820e2432e0 --optional-concurrency
